data.one_liner: Generate and parse OpenAPI specifications, producing client, server, and documentation code.
data.what_it_does: The package can read an OpenAPI spec into a Dart object and generate a full client or server library from it. It also supports generating Swagger UI static docs.
use_when: You need to generate a Dart client or server from an OpenAPI spec
You want to parse an existing spec into Dart objects for manipulation
You need to produce Swagger UI static files
avoid_when: You only need a lightweight HTTP client without code generation
You are targeting a language other than Dart
strengths: Generates both client and server code, plus Swagger UI
weaknesses: No support for non-Dart code generation
